A '''turbothruster''' was a type of [[Engine/Legends|engine]]. They were installed in [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]],<ref name="SWS" /> and on [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] bikes to travel with incredible speed.<ref name="SOTE Card">{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Swoop|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC087.jpg}}</ref> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] utilized a landspeeder turbothrusters as part of his unorthodox modifications to the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="SWS" />
